outlook.text: Ossoff leads 520,317 to 196,043 with about 18% counted. The main model has D+5.8 and alt model v2 has D+12.3, so the two disagree by a wide margin. Gwinnett and Fulton drive the lead, with projected full-count gains of +79,279 and +60,722 over pace, but both are early votes only. Cobb, DeKalb, Cherokee and Chatham have nothing in. DeKalb and Cobb should add Dem margin, Cherokee will give some back, and election-day votes in the early-only counties may trim the cushion.
